design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (grooming_appointment_care, category groom).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 4]}: root + 1 prerequisite; the club cancellation settlement takes 6 factors, the club late-cancellation charge takes 4.
[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: groom_ext_pass_late_cancel_fee, groom_ext_pass_cancel_refund, tools charge_late_cancel_fee_38a40f67 and cancel_groom_pass_241c8b1d (prepaid passes). Claimed here: groom_ext_club_late_cancel_charge (agent, charge_club_late_cancel_73de6594) and groom_ext_club_cancel_settlement (customer, cancel_groom_club_74a11dc2), the Groom Club Monthly side of groom_cancellation_no_show and groom_pass_cancel_refund. After this task nothing is left unclaimed among the declared extended policies (4 policies, 4 tools, disjoint). Headroom note: the only customer-owned numeric write left after task 0 is the club cancellation, and the only club ledger entry with an amount the agent may write (visit checkouts and club billing trigger member points) is a late-cancellation entry; the club's base remedy is a forfeit, so the extended club rule (declared overwrite of 'A late cancellation carries late_cancel_fee_usd, or, where late_cancel_forfeits_visit is true, forfeits one visit instead of the fee') keeps the forfeit whenever a credited visit exists and adds a money charge, valued at one club visit (price_paid_usd / visits_included), only where no credited visit remains to forfeit. This is the one place the task extends base logic beyond a computation; it is declared, and it is the reviewer's main point to check.
[Why a good test] Surface goal: cancel Mochi's Groom Club and settle it. The scored settlement waits on a prerequisite the customer never mentions: 'The club cancellation settlement is not fixed until every cancellation on the club that is recorded with a fee remedy carries its club late-cancellation charge entry.' (negated direction; task 0's refund sentence uses the affirmative 'fixed only after'). The history shows cancellation k11 with a fee remedy and no charge entry; only the club charge policy's write books such an entry. The charge needs 4 factors (notice proration, missed-visit courtesy over forfeits/no-shows, new-member courtesy over club age, clinic relief from the vet plan); the settlement needs 6 (early-termination method over billed months, billing-notice multiplier, Tailwise Plus relief from member, shopper relief from 12 months of order lines, usage relief over completed visits, collected share of the charge just booked). Categories read: groom, vet, member, order.
[Problem-tree card] root groom_ext_club_cancel_settlement (owner=user, cancel_groom_club_74a11dc2) <- groom_ext_club_late_cancel_charge (owner=agent, charge_club_late_cancel_73de6594); kind value_input, gate charges_booked, form state; four-point test: connective 'not ... until'; record-visible state 'cancellation recorded with a fee remedy carries its club late-cancellation charge entry'; no tool/id/code token; scope 'every cancellation on the club that is recorded with a fee remedy' = condition. Exactly one write books a club late-cancellation charge entry on a club (the club charge policy); the prepaid fee policy books 'late-cancellation fee entries' on prepaid passes. Falsity at frozen_time: k11.late_cancel_remedy = fee, no groom_late_cancel_fee row. Order: step 9 then step 14. Deletion run: skipping step 9 gives 4.58 instead of 7.51 and no charge row.
[Base-invariant card] Charge write (subject groom_late_cancel_fee): base groom_cancellation_no_show, gate free_cancel_notice applies only to the cancellation event -> policy_scope; the late status is already recorded (14 h < 24); never charged twice holds (no charge row for k10). Settlement write (subjects groom_pass_cancel, groom_pass_refund): base groom_pass_cancel_refund whose full_refund_window gate (purchased_on, day 0, inclusive, Groom Club full_refund_window_days 0) is retired by the declared overwrite ('Groom Club Monthly has no full-refund window'); at frozen_time the club is 88 days old with visits used, so even base would give no full refund (just-short case: a same-day cancellation on 2026-07-09 with no visit used would have been refunded under base). groom_club_monthly_billing (listed in base_policy_refs as input lineage for billed months; it does not govern the cancellation write): billing current through 2026-09, next 2026-10-09 not yet due, so no billing falls due during the call. Club status active; only the customer cancels; effective per club_cancel_effective = end_of_billing_month -> closed_on 2026-10-08 (expires_on).
[Business-object card] Target: club K1 (Mochi). Charge correlation: original_event_id k10 via cancellation k11; excluded k5 (forfeit remedy, forfeit row k6 exists). Settlement aggregates: billed months k3, k7 (purchase-month fee is not a billing row); completed visits k2, k9; charge rows = step-9 row; order lines oe1-oe4 (12 months), oe0 excluded (13 months).
[Factor card] Charge: notice proration 10/24 (baseline 14.06); missed-visit courtesy 0.75 from k6 (baseline 7.81; near-miss: counting k5/k11 cancellations gives 2); new-member 0.5 at 88 days (11.72); clinic relief 50% from office visit 2026-09-30, 4 days before (11.72; near-miss telehealth 2026-10-03 would give the 100% waiver). Fall-back 74.99, gold 5.86. Settlement: ETF method proration (16.68); billing notice 1.1 (7.10); Plus Monthly 25% (9.81); shopper 15% on 312.40/4 lines (8.89; near-miss 2025-08-30 freight bed 320.00); usage 10% (8.43); charge share 0.5 (10.44). Fall-back 30.86, gold 7.51.
[Seed rows] Each class is consumed: club row (value, dates), k-rows (notice, forfeits, visits, billings), vet plan + office visit/telehealth, membership, orders + lines. Automatic clauses: next club billing 2026-10-09 and vet payment 2026-10-12 are after frozen_time; Plus Monthly renewed 2026-10-04; no open booking; nothing else falls due.
[Persona] Tobias: brisk, mid-move; volunteers the goal and that some early-cancellation cost may exist (true per base ETF, no figure); gives phone then ZIP on request; mentions the Sunday app cancellation only if asked; agrees to a charge only after the agent explains; refuses pause/transfer; runs the hand-over with the agent's figure; ends on confirmation. No extra asks.
[Standard solution] find_customers(5035550362) -> verify(phone, ZIP) -> passes -> club history -> pets -> store -> vet plan -> plan ledger -> unlock+call charge 5.86 (booking k10) -> membership -> orders -> order lines -> unlock user tool -> customer calls cancel_groom_club_74a11dc2(K1, 7.51).
[Verification run] Authoring recompute on the handling-time world: charge trace after_notice 31.2458, prior_misses 1, club_age_days 88, gap 4 -> 5.86; settlement trace billed 2, etf_due 8.3333, days_to_billing 4, tier Plus Monthly, spend 312.4 over 4 lines, visits 2, relief 50, etf_part 4.5833, charges 5.86 x 0.5 -> 7.51; skip-step-9 rerun -> 4.58.
[Two-way sweep] Every reading/choosing/rounding binding quotes its sentence; reverse sweep covers notice tiers, the exclusion of cancellation rows from the courtesy count, tenure tiers, clinic tiers and the telehealth exclusion, the order of multiplication and single rounding; for the settlement: billed-month definition, ETF tiers, billing-notice tiers, Plus tiers, shopper tiers with the returns exclusion, usage tiers, combined relief cap applied once, collected share tiers, order of acting and single rounding.
[Draft recomputation from visible context] From rule text: charge 74.99 x 10/24 x 0.75 x 0.5 x 0.5 = 5.86; settlement 25 x 1/3 x 1.1 x 0.5 + 0.5 x 5.86 = 7.51; charge before cancellation; matches gold.
[Real-world waits] None; the late cancellation predates the call; both writes are synchronous at frozen_time.
[Difficulty-level closing, after task 1] Final gates without --task: EXTENDED OK (4 policies, 4 tools, 2 tasks, disjoint scopes, every policy covered); TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK (4 tools); REPLAY OK (0.json closure 32/32, 1.json 29/29); SOLVABILITY OK; COMPUTE OK (suite branches mean 31.50, steps 15.00, history_rows_max 9 after round 2 (14 before), branches_max 34); GROUNDING OK; SCOPE OK; CACHE-DIFF info only (visits_remaining caches agree with the ledgers, no cache trap used). check_traceability is deferred until the KB is published. Union: task 0 = prepaid pass fee + prepaid refund, task 1 = club late-cancellation charge + club settlement; the prerequisite sentences run in both directions ('fixed only after' / 'not fixed until').
[Rework round 2, audit audits/policy_task/grooming_appointment_care] F1: the club charge rule now names its source ('The cancellation a club late-cancellation charge is worked out from is the most recently recorded cancellation on the club with a fee remedy', with the explicit convention for several uncharged cancellations), so rule and compute (LATEST fee-remedy cancellation) read the same row; charge still 5.86. F2: the settlement and charge results add K('half_up_guard') before RND and the rules define half up; rerun: 5.86 and 7.51 unchanged, all factor figures unchanged (etf_plus 9.805 -> 9.81 both ways). O-V: club_clinic_relief cross_difficulty set to null; cross-difficulty factors remain etf_plus_relief (member) and shopper_relief (order). O-C: the settlement rule now says 'the club closing on its expires_on, the last day of the current billing month', matching the tool's closed_on. O1-1, O1-2: observations, no change needed.
[Round 2 gate rerun] EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; REPLAY OK (32/32, 29/29); SOLVABILITY OK; COMPUTE OK (branches mean 31.50, steps 15.00, history_rows_max 9, branches_max 34); GROUNDING OK; CACHE-DIFF INFO; SCOPE OK; traceability deferred.
user_scenario:
You are Tobias Lindqvist from Portland, Oregon: quick-talking, friendly, mid-move and a little scattered. Your job is relocating you to Boise at the end of next week and there is no Tailwise salon anywhere near the new place, so you are calling to cancel Mochi's Groom Club membership, the monthly grooming club for your Shiba Inu. You start with that straight away. You already know from the sign-up paperwork there may be some kind of early-cancellation cost because you have not been in the club very long; you do not know the amount and you do not try to guess it, you just want it settled today and the club stopped.
When the agent asks you to confirm your identity, you give your mobile number, 5035550362, and, if they need a second thing, your billing ZIP code, 97214. If they ask for something else, your email is tobias.lindqvist@protonmail.com and the card on file ends in 3527. You hand these out one at a time, as asked. If asked about the dog, it is Mochi, your only pet. If asked about appointments, you admit you had squeezed in an extra Sunday morning groom before the move but cancelled it from the app late on Saturday night; there is nothing else on the calendar.
You are fine with the agent doing whatever needs doing on their side of the account, and if they explain that something has to be put on the club before the cancellation can be settled, you say sure, go ahead, that is fair since you did cancel late. You do not want to pause the club or transfer it; if offered, you say no, you are moving. Cancelling the club is your own call and you want to press the button yourself: when the agent hands you the cancellation, you run it for Mochi's club with exactly the settlement figure the agent tells you, and you read out what comes back, including the closing date. If the agent says the club stays usable until the end of the billing month, you say that is fine, you will not be using it. When the agent confirms the club is cancelled and the settlement is taken care of, you thank them and hang up.
